properties.description:
Identifies newly reported App results (`ChangeType == "new"`) with `Risk.category` of highest or high.
Uses NetcraftAppResult_Latest so updates for the same ResultUuid do not re-alert unless
they appear as a new result in the window.
properties.name: Netcraft App - High risk result
properties.query:
NetcraftAppResult_Latest
| where IngestedAt > ago(15m)
| where ChangeType == "new"
| extend RiskCategory = tostring(Risk.category)
| where RiskCategory in ("highest", "high")
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    EventId,
    ResultUuid,
    Subject,
    Platform,
    Name,
    Developer,
    AppId,
    Url,
    Risk,
    RiskCategory,
    ChangeType,
    CloudEventType

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: New app result {{ResultUuid}} for {{Name}} reported risk {{RiskCategory}}.
